segments.name: Real Estate Solutions
segments.description: Runs the integrated real estate platform, covering Cash Offer property purchases and resales and real estate services for home buyers and sellers.
segments.evidence: The CODM manages the Company's operations as a single operating and reportable segment, referred to as the Real Estate Solutions segment, which includes all activities related to the Company's integrated real estate platform.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay Linkhome for properties it buys and resells through Cash Offer, and for agency, property management, renovation and mortgage referral services.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company manages its business activities on a consolidated basis, including two principal business lines: (1) Cash Offer transactions, in which the Company purchases and resells properties for customers; and (2) real estate services, including real estate agency services, property management services, home renovation services, and mortgage referral services.
